meaning: A setting that helps your battery last longer. It cuts back on things your phone does quietly in the background.
clues: It helps your phone last longer between charges.
It does this by cutting back what runs quietly in the background, not by adding power.
Many phones turn it on by themselves when the battery runs low.
On an iPhone, the same idea is called Low Power Mode.
It has two words. The first is what holds your phone's power, and the second starts with S.
assumes: Wireless charging charges a phone on a pad, with no cable
A power bank is a portable charger
Screen brightness is how bright the screen looks

decoys.meaning: Charging a phone by setting it on a pad, with no cable plugged in.
How bright the screen looks, from dim to bright.
A small portable battery you carry to charge your phone when no outlet is near.

exchange.text: I ran on a wall plug and nothing else. Not one battery worry in my whole life!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it: switch on battery saver when you are out for the day. Your phone sips power instead of gulping it.
